# Food, goods & trade
[textlink="Back to Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"]
## A colony runs on more than ore Grow ingredients, prepare food and use the appropriate cooking vessel and heat source. Sewing, tanning, canning and assembly turn workshop supplies into useful finished goods.
[textlink="Kitchen basics" link="CMUGuideCooking"] · [textlink="Find pots, bowls and workshop equipment" link="CMUGuideIndustryRecipes"]
## Make something someone needs Ask the colony for an order before filling a warehouse. Tools, parts, food and clothing all give your workshop a purpose. Market stalls support local selling; the administration and citizen consoles handle colony requests and trade services.
## Shipping is physical Use the logistics console for the colony's outside trade. Orders travel by shuttle: keep the landing area and cargo route clear, and load or unload the actual goods. Check the order and destination before sending cargo.
[bold]Small goal:[/bold] equip one miner, feed one crew, or finish one order. A working supply chain beats a room full of idle machines.
